lipo.heroTitle: Liposuction in Malaysia by Experienced Plastic Surgeon
lipo.heroDesc: Some fat pockets do not respond to dieting. We use advanced MicroAire (PAL) technology to safely remove stubborn fat safely to improve body contour and reshape your body with hospital-grade precision.
lipo.whatDesc: Liposuction (Lipoplasty) is a surgical procedure that removes excess subcutaneous fat to reshape specific areas of the body. It is
lipo.whatDesc2: a weight-loss treatment, but a precision sculpting technique for areas resistant to diet and exercise.
lipo.techSelectDesc: Dr. Soma selects the specific method based on your fat volume and desired outcome.
lipo.palDesc: Power-Assisted Liposuction uses rapid vibration to break up fat cells.
lipo.miniDesc: For slim patients with small stubborn pockets.
lipo.largeDesc: For significant contour change in safe hospital setting.
lipo.whyDesc: Liposuction requires an artistic eye and surgical precision. Dr. Soma combines medical expertise with advanced MicroAire technology to deliver natural, balanced results.
lipo.certifiedDesc: Performed by a board-certified specialist, not a general practitioner.
lipo.symmetryDesc: Precise marking techniques to ensure balanced contouring on both sides.
lipo.hospitalDesc: Full monitoring and sterile environment for maximum safety.
lipo.safetyQuote: We prioritize hospital-grade safety protocols and natural results over aggressive over-suctioning.

lipo.faqDesc: Get answers to common concerns about liposuction
lipo.faq1A: A surgical fat-removal procedure that contours and reshapes specific areas of the body by removing excess subcutaneous fat.
lipo.faq2A: Small incisions are made, a fine cannula is inserted, and fat is suctioned out using MicroAire Power-Assisted technology for smoother results and reduced trauma.
lipo.faq3Q: When will I see results after liposuction?
lipo.faq3A: You'll start noticing changes at 4–6 weeks, with the final shape visible between 3–6 months as swelling subsides.
lipo.faq4A: Results are long-lasting because fat cells removed do not regenerate. Maintaining stable weight preserves contour.
lipo.faq5Q: Can I lose 10 kg with liposuction?
lipo.faq5A: No. Liposuction is not for weight loss. It removes volume and contours the body, not kilograms.
lipo.faq6A: Pain is usually mild to moderate — similar to muscle soreness after an intense workout. Medication keeps discomfort manageable.
lipo.faq7Q: Is liposuction good or bad for you?
lipo.faq7A: When performed by a certified plastic surgeon, liposuction is safe, effective, and one of the most common aesthetic surgeries globally.
lipo.faq8Q: What is the best age to get liposuction?
lipo.faq8A: Most suitable for adults aged 20–60 with good skin elasticity.
lipo.faq9Q: Is your stomach flat after liposuction?
lipo.faq9A: Yes — if your main issue is excess fat. If loose skin is present, a Tummy Tuck may be recommended.
lipo.faq10A: Risks are low when done by a trained surgeon in a hospital setting. Dr. Soma performs liposuction with full monitoring and controlled safety protocols.
lipo.faq11Q: What body part is most painful for liposuction?
lipo.faq11A: Areas with tighter skin (e.g., flanks or inner thighs) may feel slightly more sore, but pain is manageable.
lipo.faq12Q: How long is bed rest after liposuction?
lipo.faq12A: You are encouraged to walk immediately after surgery. Most patients return to normal routines within 5–7 days.
lipo.faq13Q: Do I need to lose weight before liposuction?
lipo.faq13A: Not necessary — but being at a stable, healthy weight gives better contouring results.
lipo.faq14A: Only tiny (3–4mm) incisions hidden in natural creases. They fade significantly with time.
lipo.harvardDesc: Describes liposuction as a safe method to remove subcutaneous fat when performed by qualified surgeons.
lipo.mayoDesc: Confirms liposuction permanently removes fat cells from targeted areas.
lipo.pubmedDesc: Studies show Power-Assisted Liposuction improves precision, reduces trauma, and enhances uniformity.
